official_definition: Consecutive Blade (When Attacks) By sending 20px(Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, your opponent must block with two of their Spirits or Ultimates if possible, and simultaneously battle this Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Consecutive Blade] or [Consecutive Blade: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Consecutive Blade]", "give [Consecutive Blade]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
